rankings.summaryHtml: The Dubs really shouldn't be insulted by Vegas' fondness for the Cavs as title favorites, because the advantage tied to playing in the East is that significant. rankings.summaryHtml: The NBA Finals don't start for another 250 days, but I can't find a soul who thinks LeBron James and his Cavs won't be in them. rankings.summaryHtml: Have to admit I'm somewhat amused by the persistent fears LaMarcus Aldridge won't fit into San Antonio's share-the-wealth culture. rankings.summaryHtml: Can you be a rampant Goran Dragic fan and a Heat skeptic at the same time? rankings.summaryHtml: New coach, new court design, new pressures on Derrick Rose. All of that is certainly headline stuff in the Windy City. rankings.summaryHtml: This is such a somber time in Philly, after the tragic losses of Darryl Dawkins and Moses Malone, and thus no time to be ranting and raving about the Sixers' polarizing approach to team-building.
